title: On the Come Up
author: Angie Thomas
summary: Sixteen-year-old Bri dreams of becoming a great rapper like her late father. When a battle goes viral for the wrong reasons, she has to fight for her voice while her family struggles to pay the bills.
readIf: you like teen stories about ambition, hip-hop and finding your own voice in the face of stereotypes.
skipIf: you want a quiet, low-stakes story without much talk of race, money or the music industry.
